18//package com.google.zxing.common.detector;
19
20use crate::{
21    common::{BitMatrix, Result},
22    point, Exceptions, Point,
23};
24
25/**
26 * <p>A somewhat generic detector that looks for a barcode-like rectangular region within an image.
27 * It looks within a mostly white region of an image for a region of black and white, but mostly
28 * black. It returns the four corners of the region, as best it can determine.</p>
29 *
30 * @author Sean Owen
31 * @deprecated without replacement since 3.3.0
32 */
33const MAX_MODULES: i32 = 32;
34#[deprecated]
35pub struct MonochromeRectangleDetector<'a> {
36    image: &'a BitMatrix,
37}
38
39impl<'a> MonochromeRectangleDetector<'_> {
40    pub const fn new(image: &'a BitMatrix) -> MonochromeRectangleDetector<'a> {
41        MonochromeRectangleDetector { image }
42    }
43
44    /**
45     * <p>Detects a rectangular region of black and white -- mostly black -- with a region of mostly
46     * white, in an image.</p>
47     *
48     * @return {@link Point}[] describing the corners of the rectangular region. The first and
49     *  last points are opposed on the diagonal, as are the second and third. The first point will be
50     *  the topmost point and the last, the bottommost. The second point will be leftmost and the
51     *  third, the rightmost
52     * @throws NotFoundException if no Data Matrix Code can be found
53     */
54    pub fn detect(&self) -> Result<[Point; 4]> {
55        let height = self.image.getHeight() as i32;
56        let width = self.image.getWidth() as i32;
57        let halfHeight = height / 2;
58        let halfWidth = width / 2;
59        let deltaY = 1.max(height / (MAX_MODULES * 8));
60        let deltaX = 1.max(width / (MAX_MODULES * 8));
61
62        let mut top = 0;
63        let mut bottom = height;
64        let mut left = 0;
65        let mut right = width;
66        let mut pointA = self.findCornerFromCenter(
67            halfWidth,
68            0,
69            left,
70            right,
71            halfHeight,
72            -deltaY,
73            top,
74            bottom,
75            halfWidth / 2,
76        )?;
77        top = (pointA.y - 1f32) as i32;
78        let pointB = self.findCornerFromCenter(
79            halfWidth,
80            -deltaX,
81            left,
82            right,
83            halfHeight,
84            0,
85            top,
86            bottom,
87            halfHeight / 2,
88        )?;
89        left = (pointB.x - 1f32) as i32;
90        let pointC = self.findCornerFromCenter(
91            halfWidth,
92            deltaX,
93            left,
94            right,
95            halfHeight,
96            0,
97            top,
98            bottom,
99            halfHeight / 2,
100        )?;
101        right = (pointC.x + 1f32) as i32;
102        let pointD = self.findCornerFromCenter(
103            halfWidth,
104            0,
105            left,
106            right,
107            halfHeight,
108            deltaY,
109            top,
110            bottom,
111            halfWidth / 2,
112        )?;
113        bottom = (pointD.y + 1f32) as i32;
114
115        // Go try to find point A again with better information -- might have been off at first.
116        pointA = self.findCornerFromCenter(
117            halfWidth,
118            0,
119            left,
120            right,
121            halfHeight,
122            -deltaY,
123            top,
124            bottom,
125            halfWidth / 4,
126        )?;
127
128        Ok([pointA, pointB, pointC, pointD])
129    }
130
131    /**
132     * Attempts to locate a corner of the barcode by scanning up, down, left or right from a center
133     * point which should be within the barcode.
134     *
135     * @param centerX center's x component (horizontal)
136     * @param deltaX same as deltaY but change in x per step instead
137     * @param left minimum value of x
138     * @param right maximum value of x
139     * @param centerY center's y component (vertical)
140     * @param deltaY change in y per step. If scanning up this is negative; down, positive;
141     *  left or right, 0
142     * @param top minimum value of y to search through (meaningless when di == 0)
143     * @param bottom maximum value of y
144     * @param maxWhiteRun maximum run of white pixels that can still be considered to be within
145     *  the barcode
146     * @return a {@link Point} encapsulating the corner that was found
147     * @throws NotFoundException if such a point cannot be found
148     */
149    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
150    fn findCornerFromCenter(
151        &self,
152        centerX: i32,
153        deltaX: i32,
154        left: i32,
155        right: i32,
156        centerY: i32,
157        deltaY: i32,
158        top: i32,
159        bottom: i32,
160        maxWhiteRun: i32,
161    ) -> Result<Point> {
162        let mut lastRange_z: Option<[i32; 2]> = None;
163        let mut y: i32 = centerY;
164        let mut x: i32 = centerX;
165        while y < bottom && y >= top && x < right && x >= left {
166            let range: Option<[i32; 2]> = if deltaX == 0 {
167                // horizontal slices, up and down
168                self.blackWhiteRange(y, maxWhiteRun, left, right, true)
169            } else {
170                // vertical slices, left and right
171                self.blackWhiteRange(x, maxWhiteRun, top, bottom, false)
172            };
173            if range.is_none() {
174                if let Some(lastRange) = lastRange_z {
175                    // lastRange was found
176                    if deltaX == 0 {
177                        let lastY = y - deltaY;
178                        if lastRange[0] < centerX {
179                            if lastRange[1] > centerX {
180                                // straddle, choose one or the other based on direction
181                                return Ok(point(
182                                    lastRange[usize::from(deltaY <= 0)] as f32,
183                                    lastY as f32,
184                                ));
185                            }
186                            return Ok(point(lastRange[0] as f32, lastY as f32));
187                        } else {
188                            return Ok(point(lastRange[1] as f32, lastY as f32));
189                        }
190                    } else {
191                        let lastX = x - deltaX;
192                        if lastRange[0] < centerY {
193                            if lastRange[1] > centerY {
194                                return Ok(point(
195                                    lastX as f32,
196                                    lastRange[usize::from(deltaX >= 0)] as f32,
197                                ));
198                            }
199                            return Ok(point(lastX as f32, lastRange[0] as f32));
200                        } else {
201                            return Ok(point(lastX as f32, lastRange[1] as f32));
202                        }
203                    }
204                }
205            } else {
206                return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
207            }
208            lastRange_z = range;
209            y += deltaY;
210            x += deltaX
211        }
212        Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND)
213    }
214
215    /**
216     * Computes the start and end of a region of pixels, either horizontally or vertically, that could
217     * be part of a Data Matrix barcode.
218     *
219     * @param fixedDimension if scanning horizontally, this is the row (the fixed vertical location)
220     *  where we are scanning. If scanning vertically it's the column, the fixed horizontal location
221     * @param maxWhiteRun largest run of white pixels that can still be considered part of the
222     *  barcode region
223     * @param minDim minimum pixel location, horizontally or vertically, to consider
224     * @param maxDim maximum pixel location, horizontally or vertically, to consider
225     * @param horizontal if true, we're scanning left-right, instead of up-down
226     * @return int[] with start and end of found range, or null if no such range is found
227     *  (e.g. only white was found)
228     */
229    fn blackWhiteRange(
230        &self,
231        fixedDimension: i32,
232        maxWhiteRun: i32,
233        minDim: i32,
234        maxDim: i32,
235        horizontal: bool,
236    ) -> Option<[i32; 2]> {
237        let center = (minDim + maxDim) / 2;
238
239        // Scan left/up first
240        let mut start = center;
241        while start >= minDim {
242            if if horizontal {
243                self.image.get(start as u32, fixedDimension as u32)
244            } else {
245                self.image.get(fixedDimension as u32, start as u32)
246            } {
247                start -= 1;
248            } else {
249                let whiteRunStart = start;
250                start -= 1;
251                while start >= minDim
252                    && !(if horizontal {
253                        self.image.get(start as u32, fixedDimension as u32)
254                    } else {
255                        self.image.get(fixedDimension as u32, start as u32)
256                    })
257                {
258                    start -= 1;
259                }
260                let whiteRunSize = whiteRunStart - start;
261                if start < minDim || whiteRunSize > maxWhiteRun {
262                    start = whiteRunStart;
263                    break;
264                }
265            }
266        }
267        start += 1;
268
269        // Then try right/down
270        let mut end = center;
271        while end < maxDim {
272            if if horizontal {
273                self.image.get(end as u32, fixedDimension as u32)
274            } else {
275                self.image.get(fixedDimension as u32, end as u32)
276            } {
277                end += 1;
278            } else {
279                let whiteRunStart = end;
280                end += 1;
281                while end < maxDim
282                    && !(if horizontal {
283                        self.image.get(end as u32, fixedDimension as u32)
284                    } else {
285                        self.image.get(fixedDimension as u32, end as u32)
286                    })
287                {
288                    end += 1;
289                }
290                let whiteRunSize = end - whiteRunStart;
291                if end >= maxDim || whiteRunSize > maxWhiteRun {
292                    end = whiteRunStart;
293                    break;
294                }
295            }
296        }
297        end -= 1;
298
299        if end > start {
300            Some([start, end])
301        } else {
302            None
303        }
304    }
305}
